name: Ongole

routes.httpStatus: Discovery result available; official page readable in bounded web discovery
routes.outcome: Government of Andhra Pradesh Bhunaksha identifies itself as a cadastral mapping platform of the Survey, Settlements and Land Records department and says it integrates with Meebhoomi. Direct curl fetch timed out after 20 seconds; no login or bypass was attempted.
Official APSAC Cadastral Maps page exposes a public Web AppBuilder iframe with item id 7e3b53a1a265421483fbcbb26c275834.
Current public JavaScript/configuration inspected. It identifies web map item b54a4a9a00b441a2bdd8f993d140edd5 and portal https://apsac.ap.gov.in/gisportal.
Web map configuration identifies the official cadastral map service https://apsac.ap.gov.in/gisserver/rest/services/REVENUE/cadastral_ap_cache/MapServer.
Service metadata inspected. It exposes one Parcel layer and is a cached MapServer; capabilities are Map, not Feature Query.

Layer metadata inspected. Polygon layer; source spatial reference WKID 4326, service spatial reference WKID 3857. Safe metadata fields include objectid, dmvcd, dstrctnam, dstrctcod, mandalnam, mandalcod, villagenam, villagecod, parcelnam, parceltyp, parceldsc, remarks, and geometry shape.

Bounded anonymous exact-point request used the preserved WUP point, geometryType esriGeometryPoint, inSR 4326, outFields objectid,dmvcd,parcelnam, returnGeometry=true and outSR 4326. Service returned Requested operation is not supported by this service. This is a capability limitation, not evidence of citywide parcel absence.
Bounded map export endpoint returned a PNG URL, confirming rendering access only. It does not provide safe native parcel identities or unchanged parcel polygon geometry, so no sample was retained.

schemaAndCrs.viewerConfig: APSAC Web AppBuilder item and web-map JSON were inspected.
schemaAndCrs.geometryCrs: Layer source WKID 4326; map service/view WKID 3857 (Web Mercator). No feature geometry was returned.
schemaAndCrs.nativeIdentity: objectid is the exposed OID field, but no feature response was returned and it was not treated as a retained parcel identity.

sourceFieldMapping.parcelnam: parcel label field; not requested in retained data

safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel ID if exposed by an official service

qualification.reason: A real Andhra Pradesh cadastral map service and schema/CRS metadata are evidenced, but the public service is map-only and the bounded anonymous feature query returned unsupported; no safe native parcel ID-plus-geometry sample is available.

scopeLimits: The exact WUP point [15.5072913625198, 80.0401300493247] was preserved and not shifted.
No exact-point hit or miss was inferred from the unsupported query.
Map export access is not parcel-feature access and cannot establish citywide coverage or absence.
Bhunaksha and APSAC are state-level platforms; no Ongole municipal/district parcel custodian endpoint was independently exposed in the bounded attempt.
No GeoJSON sample is retained because no safe native identity plus unchanged full polygon was obtained.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax/account, certificate/title or personal fields were requested or retained.
uncertainty: The Andhra Pradesh cadastral viewer and parcel layer metadata are verified, but anonymous Ongole feature-query support, city coverage, stable parcel identity semantics, and update cadence remain unverified. Runtime/admission remains held.
